🐾Aria Cats Rescue! 🐾

🐾 Welcome to our rescue family ❤️

We’re a small team of friends dedicated to rescuing, treating, and giving vulnerable cats a second chance at life. Every rescue has a story, and we do everything we can to help those who have been abandoned, injured, sick, or forgotten.

We rely on donations. Your support helps provide food, medical care, and hope. 🐱❤️

🙏 Help us save more lives and cover our growing veterinary debts. Every donation means another chance.
👇Click link below to donate 🙏🐾
